hypotheses: If critic gradients dominate the joint norm, separate caps will measurably change the actor update while retaining the same loss, Adam moments and minibatch RNG.
If cap magnitude matters more than grouping, joint cap10 will change the update as much as or more than separate cap0.5.
If Adam largely cancels gradient rescaling, policy changes will remain near the default; a small-gradient observation alone will not justify a learning trial.
limits: One late IPPO checkpoint and one fresh rollout; not DMS, independent training replication, or improved-return evidence.
Only gradient clipping changes between variants. Each starts from the same checkpoint, Adam state, data and update RNG.
PPO target-KL early stopping remains active; report actual update counts rather than forcing matching counts.
A difference from the default does not establish a better update or justify selecting settings by this probe alone.
